Author: renasagi
Name: CritLuck
Punchline: Party Critical Hit, Direct Hit, Critical Direct Hit, and overall percentiles.
Description: Shows party hit counts, actual and expected rates, and individual and overall 1–100 percentiles. Use /critluck to open the window.
TestingChangelog: ACT overhaul. Run ACT with the FFXIV plugin and OverlayPlugin; start WSServer on 127.0.0.1:10501 with SSL off. Open /critluck, match the port, enable ordinary level-100 PvE scoring, and connect before pulling. Buff-aware direct-hit scores cover WAR, WHM, SAM, DNC, and PCT. Unsupported actions, pets, DoTs, missing stats/status context, and ambiguous buff boundaries are excluded. Stable 1.0 is unchanged. See the testing release notes for setup and known limits.

Author: renasagi
Name: Party Initials
Punchline: Deprecated. Use Vanilla+'s Game Config Command instead.
Description:
Party Initials is deprecated and remains available to download. Use Vanilla+'s Game Config Command feature by Ren (renasagi) instead. Enable the feature in Vanilla+ settings, then run these commands outside combat for initials:
/gameconfig control PartyListNameType 3
/gameconfig ui LogNameType 3
Use 0 for full names, 1 for Forename S., 2 for F. Surname, or 3 for F. S. Use the same value in both commands. Existing /pli and /partyinitials commands still work.
Changelog: Deprecated: use Vanilla+'s Game Config Command feature by Ren (renasagi). Party Initials remains available to download and its existing commands still work. See the plugin description for replacement commands.

Author: renasagi
Name: Client Language Override
Description: Change the client language shown to other players without changing the game's text language. Use /clientlang to choose a language or turn the override off.
TestingChangelog: Choose Japanese, English, German, or French with /clientlang. Turning the override off restores the original reported language.
